senses.gloss:
अह्नः (The last member of a
comp.) see under अहन्.

अह्नवाय्य a. Ved.
1 Not
[]
concealing.
--2 Not to be denied or set
aside.

अह्नाय ind. Instantly, speedily,
at once; अह्नाय सा नियमजं क्लममुत्ससर्ज
Ku. 5. 86; अह्नाय तावदरुणेन तमो
निरस्तं R. 5. 71; Ki. 16. 16.

आह्न a. (ह्नी f.) Daily, performed in
a day.
--ह्नं [अह्रां समूहः अञ्] A series
of days, many days,

आह्निक a. (की f.) [अह्नि भवः,
अह्ना निर्वृत्तः साध्यः ठञ्]
1 Daily, diurnal,
performed every day or on a day;
आह्निकः स्वाध्यायः daily course of study;
˚आचारः daily observances.
--2
Employed or occurring every day (as
a teacher, servant, or fever).
--कं
1 Any religious rite or duty
which is to be performed every
day at a fixed hour; अत्राह्निकं
सुरश्रेष्ठो जपते Mb.
--2 Anything to be
performed daily, such as taking
meals, bathing &c.; कृताह्निकः संवृत्तः
V. 4; समुद्रे कृताह्निकः Mv. 5.
--3 Daily
food.
--4 Daily work or
occupation, what may be read on one day.
[]
--5 A division of a work (such
as that of the Mahābhāṣya).
